state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has aggressively pursued artificial intelligence development across infrastructure, governance, and education through major investments and institutional partnerships [R1349768b, R5237da05]. The state secured large-scale data center projects, including a $15 billion Google AI data centre initiative in Visakhapatnam and significant facility allocations for Reliance [R37f1fbdf, Ra3f43300, R064e3178]. Additionally, the government advanced workforce readiness and public administration by partnering with global tech firms to train youth, integrating AI into school and university curricula, and deploying AI-driven tools for tax compliance, policing, and welfare delivery [R6e71a6d9, R9fe15d9b, Re98842fe, Rc71b947e].

state:Bihar.text: Bihar has advanced its technological capabilities through significant investments and partnerships, including CtrlS announcing a ₹10,000 crore investment for an AI data centre [Rd3f465ac]. The state government signed multiple MoUs, such as agreements with Google and Microsoft to train teachers and modernize education [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306, Rd71e810d], and partnered with ConveGenius to build a sovereign AI infrastructure [Rbc0f7b3c]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI across various sectors like healthcare, land-revenue management, and public distribution systems [R79e87d3a, Ra3ee576b, Rac954476].

state:Gujarat.text: Gujarat has advanced its AI ecosystem through major infrastructure investments, including the Data Centre Policy 2026-29 targeting Green AI capacity, a state-wide GPUaaS framework, and proposed AI hubs in GIFT City and Dholera [Re041bd74, Rd1b68bba, Ra9ed9573, R2601aa90]. The state government has also launched expansive workforce training initiatives, partnering with tech firms and establishing data and AI labs alongside a ₹20 crore mission to train 5 lakh students [Ra6932da2, R28d10b93, R96102e6b]. Public service applications span police surveillance hackathons, agricultural quality assessment, and welfare programs, though governance challenges have emerged such as high failure rates in AI driving tests and judicial scrutiny over AI-generated case citations [R051380c0, Re71562c3, Rc55b57d8, R3cc78d30].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major initiatives spanning education, public service delivery, and infrastructure development. The state has integrated AI training and vocational subjects into government schools starting from early grades, alongside plans to establish a dedicated public AI university and multiple regional centers of excellence [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, Rb77b1a7f, Rb7265c49]. Furthermore, the government has deployed AI for internal administrative tracking, agricultural monitoring, and citizen services, while simultaneously pursuing large-scale infrastructure projects like the proposed Bidadi AI township [Rf518fff6, R9d27904f, R9082b90f]. International partnerships and agreements with entities like Anthropic and ElevenLabs have additionally supported the state's goals in digital governance, voice AI adoption, and ethical regulatory frameworks [Rff273deb, R2c127a87, R9b3c768e].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has driven extensive AI adoption across governance, infrastructure, and public services, backed by a planned ₹10,000 crore ecosystem investment and a dedicated Department of Electronics, IT, and AI [R562864e1, Rbff13ca0, R55a39cb0]. Key infrastructure projects include the $11 billion Tata AI Innovation City near Navi Mumbai and large-scale data centre MoUs [Rf8ceda95, Re0b416d1]. The state has also integrated AI into law enforcement, agriculture, education, and public health through initiatives like police copilots, agricultural platforms, and mandatory teacher training [R04592b70, R2889d124, Rda0dbcb5, Rb96d46bb].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is actively pursuing a tech-driven industrial transformation, marked by major investments and infrastructure projects in artificial intelligence and data centres [R657bba09]. Key initiatives include partnerships with companies like Sarvam AI and HCL Technologies to build sovereign AI infrastructure, compute facilities, and data centres in the state [R31b27cb7, Rdf1e1271, R3a36bb44]. The government has also integrated AI across various public administration and citizen services, deploying WhatsApp chatbots, automated traffic enforcement, and AI-enabled surveillance for enhanced governance and security [R478c8c67, R8a2dd09f, R128d452b]. Additionally, Odisha is overhauling its educational framework by introducing AI courses and skill development programmes in schools and higher education institutions [Rdb5da3c5, R7b1537aa, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integration across education, governance, policing, and agriculture, highlighted by the state school board upgrading computer science curricula for classes VIII to XII to include AI [Rf4a0d422]. In the law enforcement sector, the Punjab Police has deployed AI-driven tools, voice recognition systems, and partnerships with IIT Ropar to track organized crime and dismantle international networks [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77]. Agricultural initiatives feature collaborations with IIT Ropar to deploy AI weather stations and smart advisories to improve farm productivity [R85a67327, R609b6fc5], while industrial plans include establishing an AI tower and positioning Mohali as a technology hub [R66f87829, R83b1fa54]. Concurrently, the judiciary has intervened in certain instances, with the Punjab and Haryana High Court restricting judicial officers and quashing automated notices reliant solely on AI tools [R8eacd504, R3d477cff].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has aggressively advanced its AI ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, including a planned AI City, a Sovereign AI Park partnered with Sarvam AI, and state-owned GPU clusters [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, R8b2c535d]. The government has integrated AI into public services and governance by deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for healthcare and administrative delivery, alongside AI tools for wildlife monitoring and traffic enforcement [R576baa19, R494484b4, R9a69237a, Rc4124c01]. Furthermore, the state budget emphasizes education and economic transformation by introducing AI curriculums in schools, teacher training initiatives, and specialized trades in ITIs to prepare the workforce for emerging technologies [Rfe24cede, R5742a9b1, R33fbd5a6, R47c1fd71].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has pursued extensive AI integration across public administration, governance, and infrastructure development, highlighted by the launch of the Telangana AI Innovation Hub and various centers of excellence [Rd6f74125, R998e03d5, Rafe9a4a2]. The state government has leveraged artificial intelligence for revenue collection, traffic management, agricultural weather alerts, and enhanced emergency response systems [R849548ed, ce4536fa, R57834950, R1819b706]. Additionally, officials have partnered with major technology firms to expand digital infrastructure, establish massive data center campuses, and roll out large-scale AI literacy and workforce training initiatives [R5b4a7a80, R998e03d5, R89c590e8]. At the same time, authorities have implemented internal restrictions and guidelines to address data privacy, responsible tool usage, and administrative oversight [R607d069a, Ra75d01a2].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: The Uttar Pradesh government has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure investments, policy frameworks, and targeted digital governance initiatives. Key actions include approving the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission with a ₹2,000 crore outlay, establishing robotics and AI hubs in Greater Noida and Lucknow, and launching data center policies to support large-scale AI compute facilities [Rb1cbd4df, Rb312992b, R398131aa]. Additionally, the state has integrated AI across diverse sectors by deploying surveillance for competitive exams, implementing AI tools in judicial and forensic operations, and introducing mandatory AI courses and training schemes for youth [R1e320eca, R840f85d3, R231ba3cf, R9a108180].

category:strategy_policy.text: Multiple Indian state governments are actively establishing dedicated artificial intelligence policies, missions, and infrastructure frameworks to drive digital growth. States like Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Tripura have approved formal AI and machine learning policies supported by significant financial outlays and administrative committees [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rc68da9b5]. Concurrently, states including Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Gujarat are planning specialized tech hubs and large-scale data center capacities to attract investments and support regional startups [R1b6cbab3, R3cf60d9f, Rb322fa47, R43f4ae2b]. Furthermore, several states are emphasizing workforce readiness by introducing AI training programs for students, youth, and faculty, alongside integrating AI into educational curricula and public sector governance [R4af400f2, R7cc53f61, Ra6932da2, R2c0df2e5, R8f4114ad].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and high courts have increasingly focused on the regulation, ethical deployment, and oversight of artificial intelligence across judicial, administrative, and public service domains. Several high courts, including those in Gujarat, and Punjab and Haryana, have restricted or prohibited the use of AI tools in judicial decision-making, judgment drafting, and legal research following instances of AI-generated non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504, Re614353f]. Concurrently, executive bodies and departments in states like Maharashtra, Telangana, and Karnataka have formed specialized committees and issued guidelines to frame standard operating procedures, protect confidential data, and mandate responsible AI use in governance [R9b3c768e, R40c3cafc, R607d069a, Ra75d01a2]. Furthermore, states are addressing emerging digital safety challenges, deepfakes, and data privacy through new protocols, educational frameworks, and regulatory proposals [Raf4f7b8d, Rc7b7e0d9, R0b53b3df, R7c216cfc].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments have heavily financed artificial intelligence infrastructure, data centres, and specialized missions through major budgetary allocations and investment pacts [Rd3f465ac, R3eefbde9, R297b1b1d]. Notable actions include Chhattisgarh approving Rs 500 crore for its AI Mission, Uttar Pradesh launching a Rs 2,000 crore AI mission along with a Rs 1,725 crore skill scheme, and Maharashtra clearing a Rs 500 crore agriculture AI policy [R7cc53f61, Rb312992b, Rda0dbcb5]. Furthermore, states have attracted massive multi-billion-dollar private sector and international investment proposals for green AI data centers and compute facilities [R3eefbde9, R00b3c6a6, R2269e1a7].

category:infrastructure.text: Indian state governments are aggressively scaling up AI infrastructure through massive investments in data centres, sovereign AI parks, and specialized tech hubs. Key initiatives include multi-gigawatt data centre projects, green AI computing campuses, and upcoming AI cities or innovation districts in states like Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, Maharashtra, and Gujarat [R5b4a7a80, R1349768b, Rf8ceda95, R43f4ae2b]. States are also establishing localized computing frameworks, AI universities, and dedicated Centres of Excellence to foster deep-tech research, public sector innovation, and workforce skilling [Rc16dddf8, Re041bd74, Re78dfed2, Rd1b68bba]. Furthermore, regional policies and partnerships are actively expanding digital access, edge data networks, and educational facilities into tier-2 and tier-3 locations [Rd3f465ac, Rb1015546, R2e17e58f].

category:partnership.text: Indian state governments are actively forging partnerships, Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs), and collaborations with major technology firms and academic institutions to drive artificial intelligence (AI) adoption and infrastructure development. Key initiatives include establishing massive AI data center campuses, compute hubs, and centers of excellence in states like Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Telangana, and Maharashtra [R5b4a7a80, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1]. Additionally, states are heavily focusing on capacity building by partnering with companies like Google, Microsoft, and IBM to train teachers, students, and youth in AI, digital skills, and specialized tools [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, 10e7268a]. Furthermore, governments are integrating AI into public services, healthcare, agriculture, and governance through targeted collaborations with organizations such as Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and Wadhwani AI [R65d60606, Rff273deb, R6de84b70].

category:deployment.text: State governments have widely deployed artificial intelligence across public services, including WhatsApp chatbots and voice portals for citizen engagement, revenue services, and healthcare appointments in states like Odisha, Haryana, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka [Rd731fc75, R127f881c, R576baa19, Rff273deb]. Law enforcement and security agencies are increasingly adopting AI tools, ranging from cybercrime copylots in Maharashtra and criminal tracking apps in Uttar Pradesh and Punjab to drone monitoring and automated exam surveillance [R04592b70, R7333c0ad, R840f85d3, Ra6233201]. Furthermore, states are integrating AI into administrative workflows, revenue collection, agriculture, and disaster management to enhance operational efficiency and plug leakages [Rd1807ca7, R6e71a6d9, R45e372bd, Ra8c17a13]. Affordability and localized access are also prioritized through initiatives like affordable AI-ready computers and regional language portals [R3590a0eb, Rad868781, R3158dd4a].

category:skilling.text: Numerous state governments are actively advancing AI skilling and digital education initiatives through targeted student training programs and curriculum integrations. For instance, states like Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, and Telangana have rolled out large-scale programs targeting hundreds of thousands to millions of youth and students [R4af400f2, Rb312992b, Ra6932da2, R3bfd0d73]. Furthermore, states such as Punjab, Karnataka, and Tripura are systematically embedding artificial intelligence as a mainstream or vocational subject directly into school classrooms [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R3fff65a8]. To successfully deliver these educational initiatives, several states have forged strategic partnerships with major technology firms and institutions like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon for comprehensive teacher capacity building and digital infrastructure development [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, R998e03d5].

category:events_outreach.text: Indian states have actively engaged in AI policy outreach through numerous summits, conferences, and technical workshops focused on governance, digital health, and technological innovation [Rf73e4f3d, R3fff65a8, Rfur41fa83]. Several regions, including Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, and Uttar Pradesh, have utilized national platforms like the India AI Impact Summit and regional conferences to forge partnerships, showcase local advancements, and align with broader national frameworks [R84a7e58c, R4348031c, R4d3bfbb9]. Additionally, states like Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Karnataka have prioritized hands-on engagement through large-scale hackathons, police surveillance challenges, and major technology summits centered around artificial intelligence and robotics [R28ccc09b, Rec3b838b, Rfe753238].

state:Kerala.text: The Kerala government has undertaken a major administrative and infrastructural overhaul by rebranding its IT department to focus on AI and future technologies, alongside launching Centers of Excellence and the Kerala Artificial Intelligence Mission [Re04f7ee8, Ref58a154, 9641614e]. Significant investments and policy actions include establishing large-scale AI data centers, deploying AI-driven tools across public services, and integrating artificial intelligence into disaster management, healthcare monitoring, and agriculture [R3391f5dc, R12618502, Re04f7ee8, Ra525c46d]. Additionally, the state has prioritized public safety and education through cyber safety protocols, free AI-assisted competitive exam coaching portals, and AI deployments for police and traffic management [Raf4f7b8d, Rbf1453e2, R70ecdb68, R70e049dc].

category:governance_body.text: Several state governments have established dedicated ministries, departments, and high-level committees to drive artificial intelligence initiatives in governance [R2dd69e13, R6f0677ec, R7571f900]. Kerala and Tamil Nadu created specialized AI portfolios and ministries, while states like Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Bihar formed multi-tier panels, ethical committees, and special cells to oversee policy implementation and land-revenue or educational administration [R9b3c768e, R5afedf9c, Ra3ee576b]. Additionally, police departments across multiple states—including Telangana, Haryana, West Bengal, and Maharashtra—have initiated AI task forces, cells, and expert panels to enhance policing, cybercrime management, and regulate wearable tech [Ra1409382, Ra6b5d331, R6e827395, Rba8badb1].

overall.text: Indian state governments are actively advancing AI integration across infrastructure, governance, education, and policy frameworks. Numerous states are developing major technology hubs, data centres, and specialized policies, such as Maharashtra's AI Policy 2026 and Tamil Nadu's planned AI city and sovereign AI park [R562864e1, R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a]. Educational initiatives are also widespread, with states like Punjab, Bihar, and Karnataka introducing AI into school curricula and training programs [Rf6319e99, R4af400f2, R8176ca19]. Additionally, regional law enforcement and administration are adopting AI through tools like smart voice systems, crime copilot platforms, and governance portals [R04592b70, Rd731fc75, R7333c0ad].

state:Assam.text: Assam has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, infrastructure, and public services by mapping numerous departmental proposals and launching a foundational AI roadmap [R416e5d33, R4203359c]. The state has commissioned its first government-owned GPU cluster, partnered with Google to build an AI Centre of Excellence, and introduced administrative tools like the ALISA platform in the Legislative Assembly [R936eb0aa, Red858166, Rdc7ff729]. Furthermore, Assam is integrating AI into education through teacher training programs with Google and UNICEF, deploying attendance systems in government schools, and expanding technology into healthcare, flood management, and wildlife conservation [R39b50ddb, R9c3a4d8c, R9c52da90, Ra093ebca].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is actively advancing its digital economy and governance through the Chhattisgarh AI Mission, which includes a ₹500 crore investment over five years and plans for a major AI data center park [R7cc53f61, Recb4eed4]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence into multiple sectors, partnering with Google India to train two lakh teachers under an AI-enabled education campaign while also deploying smart surveillance and tracking tools for wildlife conservation and policing [R398fad0d, R8958cba0, R1dec6260, Rd2fe75d0]. Additionally, foundational infrastructure and educational initiatives are expanding as the government introduces specialized AI and technology training programs across schools, engineering institutions, and ITIs [R8ae280e0, Rf000da13, R5fcb3ecb].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana is actively advancing its digital governance and AI capabilities by planning dedicated AI hubs in Gurugram and Panchkula, establishing an AI sandbox, and working with the World Bank on a multi-crore AI development program [R2fc878d0, R03b25e4d, R793e88e8]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, deploying AI tools for health screening such as tuberculosis detection, launching smart educational initiatives including robotics and coding labs in schools, and deploying AI-driven surveillance for agriculture, drone-based governance, and policing [R0a41f591, Reb76be7f, Rdb9464b3, Ra6b5d331]. Furthermore, administrative efficiency and public service delivery are being enhanced through AI applications in land services, family identification data management, and legislative functions [R4f453e9d, R25505a25, R7939cefb].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across education, governance, healthcare, and environmental management to enhance public service delivery and operational efficiency. Key initiatives include launching AI-based digital learning platforms like 'Padhai with AI' for students, deploying AI tools for forest intelligence and ecological restoration, and updating health schemes with fraud-detection technologies [Rb23a865a, Re6fc0429, Rc3a3d3b4]. Additionally, the state is leveraging AI for disaster risk resilience, administrative automation, and tracking narcotics syndicates [R26835c79, R1ba6a5ba, Rc0aeb7f8].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced its technological capabilities by unveiling the AI Policy 2026 and the Jharkhand AI Vision-2050 roadmap, targeting substantial private investments, job creation, and digital governance across sectors [Rb9553546, R927ec078, R4b4e0b34]. The state is integrating artificial intelligence into public education through smart classrooms, specialized teacher training, and dedicated AI builder bootcamps for rural and tribal youth [R19745493, R95bbe8d6, R9a4e609b]. Healthcare services are similarly being modernized via digital health conclaves, AI-powered diagnostic partnerships, and new automated medicine tracking systems [Rb7cd9ee5, Rfd41fa83, R75cf7a06]. Additionally, administrative frameworks, judiciary data centers, infrastructure safety, and wildlife monitoring are increasingly utilizing AI tools and surveillance systems [R558f4a5f, Re675872a, Rde702427, R6988332a].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across public administration, infrastructure, and governance, highlighted by major investments and partnerships with tech entities like Google Cloud [R6473839f]. The state has deployed AI-based surveillance and monitoring systems for public safety, security at religious events like the Simhastha Kumbh, and civic procurement audits [R12d4ab71, R085470af, R4c96f220]. Additionally, AI applications are being introduced in healthcare, tourism, and police administration to optimize public service delivery and operational efficiency [Re9890866, R583299ef, R79849bf9].

state:Manipur.text: The state of Manipur has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public sector domains, highlighted by initiatives in digital governance, cybersecurity, and tribal welfare [R8e91e0e8, Rdc31ca32, Re9f95033]. Significant partnerships include an MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to expand multilingual AI, as well as collaborations with Microsoft [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. Furthermore, academic and institutional efforts have advanced AI applications through workshops, research colloquiums, and the launch of translation tools like the 'Ishaan' app [R49d826c3, R546f135d, R13590541]. Other notable developments involve exploring AI to curb wildlife trafficking and focusing on digital tourism [R7249ca9d, R3413274d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, public health, agriculture, and education, highlighted by initiatives like the Regional AI Impact Conference and partnerships with organizations such as Wadhwani AI [Rd7994ab1, R84a1eeb7, Rf1f88f85]. Significant actions involve drafting a new IT policy focused on AI, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence, and introducing AI-enabled interactive learning and skill training programs for youth [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R24be49c9, Rc935224b]. Additionally, the state has deployed AI solutions for administrative governance, facial recognition integration, and landslide mapping [R6dd95eb1, Rfbdf90e5].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has focused heavily on policy development and partnerships, notably launching India's first state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build an AI ecosystem and innovation hub [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state has also advanced technology integration in education through the AI Skill Initiative for government school students, robotics and VR labs, and an AI-powered school monitoring system [R3fff65a8, R311a6da8, R20047d48]. Furthermore, significant actions include upgrading healthcare with AI-enabled medical devices and X-ray machines, conducting AI training for women's employment, and urging the police to adopt AI for traffic management [R2235629e, R8edb04a8, Rb70cb3d9]. Leadership has continually promoted digital skills and research through university engagements and awareness drives [R8b94d567, Rb7a643a3].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across education, governance, and environmental conservation, marked by summits like the Devbhoomi AI Summit and dedicated budget allocations [Rfcd6274a, Rf99328af]. The state mandated AI education across its 45 universities to train one thousand youth annually, alongside teacher capacity-building and specialized technical courses [Rcea6d545, Rb0eb9126, Rb592925a]. Governance and public services leverage AI for tax evasion detection, cyber crime helplines, disaster prediction, and wildlife monitoring such as acoustic surveillance and railway intrusion detection systems [Recb1f69d, R549f779d, Rca18ab02, R82962675, R0056f175]. Additionally, the government has deployed AI voice portals for regional languages and tech tools to secure portals and manage traffic enforcement [R3158dd4a, Rc3235cc0, R82f7d4b6].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal has actively pursued AI integration across industrial, educational, and governance sectors to spur economic growth and modernization [Rf93d2652, R2434d991, R2f526d3f]. Significant policy actions include the approval of a draft industrial policy focusing on AI and data centres, alongside educational initiatives such as school modernization roadmaps and Oracle partnerships to train students [R0c1ea7de, Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1]. Additionally, the state has deployed AI for public safety through police tech upgrades, specialized apps, and surveillance training [R6e827395, R08e415eb, R5118fef0], while also exploring artificial intelligence to improve urban civic services [Rebcdd9ec].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has advanced artificial intelligence integration across multiple sectors, highlighted by the approval of the AI-ML Policy 2026 and the launch of a free foundational AI course for citizens [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. Key initiatives include deploying AI for agricultural crop monitoring through partnerships with Wadhwani AI, enhancing public service delivery via the AI-enabled Rajasthan Sampark platform, and strengthening public safety using facial recognition and traffic surveillance [R6de84b70, Rcaf01e51, Rd7e6b721, R0af96cb6]. Furthermore, the state has leveraged AI applications to improve healthcare tracking for diseases like Type 1 diabetes, optimize wildlife and resource conservation, and update educational frameworks [Re21823b6, R0d19612d, Rf789607f].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland has actively advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, agriculture, and infrastructure since late 2025. Significant actions include the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, the unveiling of the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness, and the launch of an AI-powered unified digital agriculture ecosystem [R6f55ee54, Ra8c17a13, R3a286812]. The state has also focused heavily on education, capacity building, and digital governance through faculty development workshops, hackathons like "Agentic AI Saksham," and school education reform plans [Rb7d1d850, R8a5917e4, R212a4f6f, Ree819f7b]. Additionally, administrative reach has been expanded through initiatives such as the NSEDM WhatsApp chatbot for skill development services and academic seminars on AI and green sustenance [Rd629521c, R1ee21379].
